dedupe_keys.name: public construction works list of macao dsop

description: The Macao Public Works Bureau publishes a list of public construction works on its website, with each project's name, contractor, start date and completion date, alongside pages for projects that are planned, in progress and completed. Entries read include land reclamation and embankment works for a construction waste landfill, a pedestrian link from New Urban Zone A to the Macao peninsula, temporary car parks, footbridges and a shield tunnel section of the Light Rail East Line extension, some with start and completion months in 2026 and 2027. The site also has pages on special development projects, such as the Light Rail system and its East Line, the fourth Macao–Taipa bridge, the Inner Harbour South stormwater pumping station and sewers, the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge and the Islands medical complex, and thematic sites on slope safety, roads and drainage, cross-sea bridges and disaster prevention and reduction works, with typhoon information and flood control measures. Access is free online; no licence is stated. Caveats: the list is in Chinese and Portuguese, and dates are missing for some projects. Coverage is Macao. It supports capacity planning and hazard exposure analysis of planned and ongoing infrastructure, such as flood defences and transport links exposed to typhoons and storm surge; related records are the Chile national infrastructure project portfolio and the GeoMOP portal of Chile.
